title: Lightdash marketing-site PageSpec
description: A page composition: one template, one route, chrome axis + theme, and an ordered list of section nodes. Closed enums everywhere; additionalProperties:false at every level; per-section content contracts generated from sections/*.json (x-maxWords = the contract maxWords, checked by verify_all.py). semantic_validate.py adds everything JSON Schema cannot express (template node-list match, graph rules, word counts, live-endpoint scan).

mode.description: clone = faithful reconstruction of the Lightdash clone (real assets and copy allowed as evidence); generation = a new page for another brand: semantic_validate.py rejects every clone-only / blocked asset role and all Lightdash identity, copy, claims, URLs and embeds (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).

assetRef.description: A human-fillable asset slot id, never a URL or file path.

style.description: Optional per-node token references (catalog ids "category.name" from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json, e.g. "color.brand-purple", "spacing.24", "fontFamily.inter"). Never raw values. semantic_validate.py checks TOKEN_UNKNOWN / TOKEN_RAW_COLOR / TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING / TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT / TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH / TOKEN_SCOPE / TOKEN_CATEGORY.
